description: This file defines an interface 'MessageFormatterInterface' in the 'GuzzleHttp' namespace, specifying a method for formatting HTTP message logs including requests, responses, and errors.

classes.name: MessageFormatterInterface
classes.description: An interface that mandates a 'format' method for producing formatted string messages for HTTP requests, responses, and errors.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Constructs a formatted message string using an HTTP request, optional response, and optional error.
